shared.chania:
18–19 SEP · CHANIA

To Maridaki · seafood in Splantzia

Regional or food illustration; not a photograph of this venue.

A good fit for the Chania evening: a changing fish, seafood and vegetable menu close to the old-town stay. Ask what is fresh, then build a shared table around fish and seasonal vegetables.

Official site says closed Sundays: choose Friday or Saturday, not departure day. Call to confirm a table. Daskalogianni 33.

Restaurant information ↗ Call To Maridaki Open in Maps ↗

shared.lykos:
20–21 SEP · SFAKIA

A slow dinner at Akrogiali

Regional or food illustration; not a photograph of this venue.

You are already sleeping above the taverna in Lykos. Make that the experience: swim, shower, sit down with a view and ask what the kitchen has that day.

Look for grilled fish, greens with lemon and olive oil, then a Sfakian cheese-and-honey pie if available. This is our low-effort route pick, not a verified daily menu.

Open in Maps ↗

Ask the property about dinner and the catch of the day. Boat timing and luggage need separate coordination before arrival.
shared.south:
22 SEP · SOUTH COAST

Choose one beach to linger at

After Preveli, choose a longer pause at Triopetra or Agios Pavlos instead of treating both as compulsory stops. Bring a picnic or ask your hotel for an open seasonal taverna.

Leave enough daylight for the drive to Agia Galini. A relaxed swim and lunch can be the signature experience of this day.

See this day’s route →

No table reservation needed for a self-organised picnic. Bring water, food, swimwear and a towel; walking shoes for Preveli.
shared.peskesi:
23 OR 26 SEP · HERAKLION

Peskesi · the special Cretan meal

Our pick for one more deliberate food experience. The restaurant also advertises an olive-oil tasting with food pairing (about two hours, by arrangement).

Choose a meal on 26 Sep after settling in, or a planned daytime slot on 23 Sep that still protects the 19:00 car return. The tasting is optional and unbooked; check availability.

shared.psaraki:
24 SEP · SANTORINI

To Psaraki · Vlychada harbour

Regional or food illustration; not a photograph of this venue.

A seafood lunch or early dinner option after settling into Perissa, if you feel like an outing. Suggested order from the published menu: Santorini fava, grilled sardines and boiled greens; add shrimp saganaki for tomato, feta and ouzo flavours.

This needs a taxi or arranged transport from Perissa. Confirm a table and the return ride. For whole fish, ask the weight and total price before ordering.

24 SEP · OPTIONAL SWAP

Santo Wines · a caldera tasting

Regional or food illustration; not a photograph of this venue.

Choose this instead of the Vlychada outing if the view and a wine tasting appeal more. The visitor centre is in Pyrgos; arrange transport from Perissa and book directly.

shared.sfakian:
SFAKIA

Sfakian pita

A thin cheese-filled pie with honey: a regional treat to ask for around Sfakia or Loutro. It contains wheat; consider sharing one for the taste.
shared.santorini-food:
SANTORINI

Fava, capers & tomato fritters

Try the local golden pulse purée with olive oil, onion and capers. Tomatokeftedes are tomato fritters: worth tasting, but usually made with flour. Ask how each dish is prepared.
shared.arrival:

Regional or food illustration; not a photograph of this venue.

Vardis Taverna on Kyanis Aktis is a nearby option for Greek salad, vegetable meze and seafood. Listings indicate late Thursday opening, but ask whether the kitchen is still serving before heading over.

shared.chania-wander:
Harbour, backstreets & a long lunch

Walk the Venetian harbour and Splantzia at an easy pace. Share dakos, seasonal vegetables and fish. On 19 Sep, keep this as an optional short evening walk after Falasarna, depending on your energy.

No advance booking for the harbour walk. Bring comfortable shoes, water and sun protection. The Falasarna alternative needs a separate beach kit.
shared.plakias:

Regional or food illustration; not a photograph of this venue.

shared.opening-lunch:
18 SEP · RETHYMNO STOP

1600 Raki BaRaki · a proper first lunch

Make the first full day a food occasion: stop in Rethymno on the drive to Chania for a leisurely Cretan lunch at Raki BaRaki, part of Avli. The restaurant specifically welcomes lunch and serves shared dishes with creative local cooking.

Plan around 12:30–13:00, allowing for the 10:00 rental pickup, driving, parking and a short walk into the old town. Leave roughly two hours for lunch and a wander, then continue to Chania for an afternoon check-in. These times are planning estimates; confirm the table and kitchen hours.

Ask about vegetable dishes, mushrooms, cheese meze and the day’s seafood options. Avli’s courtyard restaurant is a more elaborate alternative if it can offer a suitable lunch sitting.

dishes:
A little menu decoder

Each photograph shows the named dish, not a serving from a recommended restaurant. Recipes vary between kitchens.

Dakos

Barley rusk topped with tomato, cheese and olive oil. For a version without bread, ask for a tomato salad instead.

Horta

Cooked leafy greens with olive oil and lemon: a lovely fresh counterpoint to fish and richer meze.

Gemista

Tomatoes or peppers stuffed with rice and herbs. Ask whether the filling also contains meat.

Briam

Slow oven-baked vegetables with olive oil. A good plate to share alongside fish or legumes.

Fava

A silky yellow pulse purée, often served with onion, olive oil and capers; a good local choice in Santorini.

Tomatokeftedes

Santorini tomato fritters with herbs. Usually made with flour; ask the kitchen about the preparation.

SFAKIA

Sfakian pita

A thin cheese-filled pie with honey: a regional treat to ask for around Sfakia or Loutro. It contains wheat; consider sharing one for the taste.

AT THE TABLE

A useful ordering shortcut

Try: “Grilled fish, greens, a vegetable dish and fava to share.” Ask whether fish is floured before grilling or frying, and whether sauces contain flour. Menus and kitchen preparation vary; none of these venues is labelled gluten-free here.

days.title: Heraklion · arrival
days.intro: A tasty, easy dinner near the hotel, the right address and the flight document.

before: Save flight documents and the hotel address offline; keep passports within reach.
Keep the approved late check-in details handy. Ask whether the nearby kitchen is still serving before heading out.
pack: Passports, travel documents, phone, charger and power bank in the cabin bag.
An overnight kit and a light layer, so there is no need to unpack everything on arrival.

days.title: Chania · arrive & wander
days.intro: Collect the car, enjoy a special lunch in Rethymno and arrive in Chania at an easy pace.

before: Confirm the 10:00 car pickup point. Have the licence, rental documents and payment card required by the rental company ready.
Call Raki BaRaki / Avli to check lunch availability. Choose one optional stop and allow time for parking and the walk into Rethymno.
pack: Comfortable walking shoes, water, hat, sunscreen and sunglasses.
If adding a beach stop: swimwear, a compact towel and a bag for wet clothes.
Car charger, downloaded route and an accessible day bag; keep luggage out of sight.

days.title: Falasarna · beach & a relaxed evening
days.intro: A later start: aim to leave around 10:00–10:30, beach and a light lunch, then a flexible return and likely pizza near the hotel.

before: Check wind and waves before leaving; aim for 10:00–10:30 if ready, with 1–1h15 driving. Later departure simply shifts the beach time.
Umbrella and sunbeds are not booked; check availability and price on arrival. Keep lunch and the return time flexible.
Ask Polixeny’s reception for the free beach towels before leaving for Falasarna; no deposit is required.
pack: Swimwear, hotel beach towels, hats, sunglasses, sunscreen and plenty of water.
Sandals, dry clothes, a wet bag, phone and car charger.

days.title: Sfakia & Lykos
days.intro: A gorge, an unhurried taverna evening and the practicalities of Lykos.

before: Confirm the selected gorge, weather and current access before setting off; choose the easier alternative if conditions do not suit.
Agree parking, luggage and the last leg to Akrogiali with the property. Confirm boat timing and the return from the walk; do not assume an on-demand boat.
pack: Walking shoes with grip, enough water for the full walk, snacks, hat and sunscreen.
Small day bag, charged phone, offline route, compact first-aid kit and a light overnight bag if luggage stays with the car.
Swimwear, towel and a dry bag if adding a swim or boat ride.

days.title: Loutro coast → Plakias
days.intro: Coastal time, car retrieval and a good point to ask about laundry.

before: Confirm the Loutro / Glyka Nera boat schedule and the last return before committing to a beach stop. Keep the Sfakia road alternative available.
Check current access before adding Kourtaliotiko. Ask Sofia about laundry timing before dropping off clothes.
pack: Swimwear, towel, sun protection, drinking water and snacks for the beach.
Shoes with grip for rocky paths, dry clothes and a waterproof pouch for phone and documents.
Laundry in a separate bag if the hotel confirms a suitable service.

days.title: Preveli → Agia Galini
days.intro: Choose a beach to linger at, then an easy arrival on the south coast.

before: Choose which beaches to keep; allow energy and time for the climb back from Preveli. Check wind and sea conditions before driving to exposed beaches.
Ask Astoria whether laundry can be returned dry before tomorrow’s checkout.
pack: Swimwear, compact towel, water, snacks, hat and sunscreen.
Walking shoes for the steps and paths, beach footwear and a bag for wet swimwear.

days.title: Back to Heraklion
days.intro: A flexible final drive, car return and preparation for the early ferry.

before: Pick Phaistos or Matala as the main optional stop. Check opening and last-entry times for the archaeological site before leaving.
Confirm the rental return bay and fuel policy. Aim to reach the return area by 18:00 for the 19:00 deadline.
Prepare tomorrow’s ferry tickets and a small morning bag tonight; confirm the early ride to the port.
pack: Sun protection, water and comfortable shoes; swimwear and towel only if keeping Matala beach.
Rental paperwork, fuel receipt if relevant, and all loose belongings from the car.

days.title: Santorini · settle into Perissa
days.intro: Arrive, check in and choose at most one extra outing.

before: Complete operator check-in and save the actual ferry tickets: the booking email is not the boarding pass.
Have the Roula Villa address ready for the port taxi; ask about leaving bags before the room is ready.
If choosing a winery tasting or a particular restaurant, check availability and book the desired slot. Keep the arrival day flexible.
pack: Ferry tickets, passports, charged phone, water and a light layer for the cabin.
A separate beach kit with swimwear, towel and sunscreen, accessible before check-in.

days.title: Santorini · wedding day
days.intro: Keep today spacious and the celebration at the centre.

before: Confirm the wedding’s exact time, venue and transport with the family. Allow time to return, shower and get ready.
Arrange tomorrow’s port taxi and ask about keeping luggage after the 11:00 checkout.
pack: Wedding clothes, suitable shoes and any accessories; a light layer for the evening.
For a short morning swim: swimwear, towel and sun protection. Keep dry clothes ready.

days.title: Santorini → Heraklion · final dinner
days.intro: An easy morning, the ferry back and one special last meal.

before: Confirm the 15:45 ferry and the port pickup time; save the actual return tickets offline.
Check whether the dinner reservation was confirmed. The Peskesi request for 20:00 is still unconfirmed.
Pack for the morning flight and confirm tomorrow’s airport taxi before going out.
pack: Ferry tickets, passports, water, light layer and a change of clothes handy for dinner after arrival.

days.title: Heraklion · homeward
days.intro: The airport taxi and flight details, all together.

before: Complete airline check-in if available and confirm the 07:30 airport taxi for flight BZ753 at 11:05.
Check the room, safe, chargers and any stored luggage before leaving.
pack: Passports, boarding passes, phone and essentials in the cabin bag; keep them accessible.
A light layer and a small snack for the journey.
